title: stable-articulation-cell
description: The corner of the articulation-cell partition where both token and claim are articulated (yes, yes), told both - the terminus of the token-before-claim progression. Absorbing: no further telling moves the cell. It refines the articulation cell by fixing both statuses positive.

token.description: the identity-carrying token side is articulated

claim.description: the content-carrying claim side is articulated
